improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the pricing starting point and 'Claude-powered' differentiator builds trust and sets expectations.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice-powered support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately names the product and positions it as a partnership rather than just a tool, building trust. The subheading highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while removing friction with a clear free trial CTA and no-card reassurance — directly addressing conversion barriers for business professionals evaluating new tools.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion-point question: what happens at the paywall. It reassures prospects that the trial is genuinely free, clearly explains pricing without pressure, and highlights the value they unlock by becoming a member—reducing friction and building trust at the decision moment.
